question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

My best friend always _______ to me and is so non-judgmental.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"listens"** means to give one's attention to a sound or to take notice of and act on what someone says. (सुनता है)

 
 
• **Example: **She** listens** carefully to her teacher's instructions.
 
 
 
• **"listens"** is the third person singular form of the verb "listen," which is required here to match the subject "My best friend." (सुनता है)
 
 
• **Example: **He **listens** to music every evening.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Listening** (सुनना): The gerund or present participle form of "listen."

 
 
• **Example:** Listening to music can be very relaxing.
 
 
 
• **Listen** (सुनो): The base form of the verb "listen."
 
 
• **Example:** Please listen to what I am saying.
 
 
 
• **Listener** (श्रोता): A person who listens.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a good listener and always pays attention to others.
